title: No man's land
summary: Face the trenches of World War I in a PS1-style first-person game about the fear of combat.
details:
About the game

A PS1-style FPS about trench warfare in WW1. The game treats war as a frightening experience, with a focused play session inside the trenches.

Controls

Move: WASD
Shoot: Left click
Jump: Space

title: SCP 173 Simulator
summary: Become SCP-173. Hunt the humans inside a containment facility in this role-reversal horror game.
details:
About the game

A role-reversal horror game built for GMTK Game Jam 2023. The player controls SCP-173 inside a containment facility.

This game contains animations of humans dying, but no visible blood.

Controls

Keyboard and mouse.

Install instructions

Download the ZIP file, extract it, and run SCP 173 Simulator.exe.

title: Crystal Stealer
summary: Take control of an astronaut and collect three crystals in a focused 3D platforming challenge.
details:
About the game

An astronaut platformer built for Coursera’s 3D Platformer course. Two added levels put the crystal hunt across lava hazards, with tutorial text and post-processing effects.
credits: Made by Iliya Soleimani using assets from MSU.

title: Neon Shooter Mayhem

details:
About the game

An arcade prototype built in two days for Brackeys Game Jam 2023.1. Choose between two abilities before a run. This version remains a work in progress.

title: CubeGame
summary: Take on a world ruled by bosses. Set your own respawn point and use electrical platforms to cross the toughest sections.
details:
About the game

A mechanics-driven 2D platformer set in a world ruled by bosses. Take control of a cube with tools that change how you cross each level.

How it plays

Respawn flag: Place a flag to choose where you return after hitting lava. Without a flag, you lose health and return to the starting point.

Electrical platforms: Cross difficult sections at the cost of one battery charge. Buy more charges at the shop and decide where to use them.

Controls

Move: WASD
Jump: Space
Shoot: E
Interact: R
Place flag: F
Menu selection: Enter or left click
Menu navigation: Arrow keys

PlayStation controllers are supported. The in-game controls menu lists gamepad bindings. Play without DS4Windows for the recommended setup.

title: Station Invasion

details:
About the game
